1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, __wherein the non-native compartment is engineered to contain a heterologous enzyme not naturally present in the BMC operon__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo __and the heterologous enzyme is functionally integrated within the compartment__.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme __selected from enzymes not naturally encoded within the corresponding native BMC operon__.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes __wherein at least one targeted enzyme is heterologous to the BMC operon__.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence __and is not naturally associated with the BMC polypeptide__.

6. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide __and the cell further comprises at least one heterologous enzyme not naturally present in the eut operon__.

7. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 6 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide __and the non-native compartment comprises at least one enzyme heterologous to the eut operon__.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides __derived from different bacterial species or operons and assembled together with at least one heterologous enzyme__.

9. (Original) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons __and the compartment comprises at least one enzyme not naturally encoded in any of the source operons__.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag __and the non-native compartment comprises at least one heterologous enzyme__.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one heterologous enzyme not naturally present in the corresponding BMC operon, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and the heterologous enzyme, and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide and functionally containing the heterologous enzyme.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium __and the heterologous enzyme is not naturally present in the host cell's native BMC operons__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae __and the heterologous enzyme is derived from a different bacterial species or operon__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli __and the heterologous enzyme is not naturally encoded in E. coli__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae __and the polynucleotide encodes at least one heterologous BMC polypeptide or heterologous enzyme__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast __and the polynucleotide encodes both BMC polypeptides and at least one enzyme not naturally present in yeast__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae __and the BMC polypeptides are heterologous to the yeast__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae __and the polynucleotide encodes at least one heterologous enzyme__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga __and the polynucleotide encodes heterologous BMC polypeptides and at least one heterologous enzyme__.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product __wherein the enzyme is heterologous to the BMC operon__; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product __and produce a desired metabolic output__.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product __not naturally produced by the host cell__.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor __not naturally synthesized by the host cell__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production __not naturally produced by the host cell__.

25. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate __and the compartment sequesters toxic intermediates__.

26. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments __wherein the compartments contain the heterologous enzyme__.

27. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag __and the compartments contain heterologous enzymes__.

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments __wherein at least one compartment comprises a heterologous enzyme not naturally present in the BMC operon__.
